description: Defines the QuicTraceVisitor class for tracing QUIC connection events, including packet sending, acknowledgment, loss, window updates, version negotiation, and network parameter adjustments.

classes.name: QuicTraceVisitor
classes.description: A visitor class that records QUIC trace protocol buffer data for a QuicConnection.

methods.name: QuicTraceVisitor
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the visitor with a specific QuicConnection.

methods.name: OnPacketSent
methods.description: Handles the event of a packet being sent, recording relevant data.

methods.name: OnAdjustNetworkParameters
methods.description: Handles adjustments to network parameters like bandwidth and RTT.

methods.name: trace
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the trace object being recorded.

methods.name: ConvertTimestampToRecordedFormat
methods.description: Converts QuicTime into a microsecond delta relative to connection start.

methods.name: PopulateFrameInfo
methods.description: Populates a quic_trace::Frame message from a QuicFrame.

methods.name: PopulateTransportState
methods.description: Populates a quic_trace::TransportState message from the connection.
